metaDescription: Order custom direct to film outdoor products for your team. Durable, full-color prints on gear. Get a quote today.
introHtml: Direct to film (DTF) printing allows you to apply vibrant, detailed artwork onto outdoor gear without the texture or limitations of traditional screen printing. This method excels on polyester blends, nylon jackets, and performance fabrics commonly used for company picnics, trail runs, or job site sun protection. DTF transfers bond durably with the fabric, resisting peeling through repeated washings and exposure to sun or rain. For bulk orders that need to look sharp after a season of use, DTF delivers crisp logos and gradient-rich designs that stay put.
